svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Component · Metadata info · interval · narrow
svg.desc: Mirrors MetadataInfoSection in App/MetadataPanelSections.swift — the read-only group under the Gallery preview panel's action buttons: what the camera and the file said (the imported layer only), never editable here. Rows appear only when the resolved record has them; a project whose frames disagree shows nothing of the whole and the copy 'Varies by frame — choose This frame.'; before the reader has landed, 'Reading the files…'; a file with nothing, 'Nothing in the file.'. Demo content is the _WEX3518 Lightroom export set the panel was verified with (photo) and an iPhone interval JPEG shoot (interval). The GPS row carries an Open in Maps link (SF Symbol map, LL.accent).
